business.name: Harbor & Pine Landscape Co.
business.tagline: Gardens that look designed, not mowed.
business.description: Harbor & Pine helps homeowners plan, plant, and care for gardens that fit the property and the way they live. Start with a site visit, a clear scope, and a seasonal plan for the work ahead.
business.offer: A site visit and a clear scope before work begins

services.name: Garden design
services.description: Measured planting plans that fit the property, the light, and the way the garden will be used.

decisionSupport.scope: Discuss the site, the light, the soil, and the way you want to use the garden before choosing plants.
decisionSupport.nextStep: Begin with a site visit so the plan can respond to the property instead of a generic plant list.
decisionSupport.preparation: Bring photos of the space, a rough idea of budget, and the parts of the garden that already work.

services.name: Garden maintenance
services.description: Seasonal care for beds, hedges, and lawns, with a clear list of what each visit includes.

decisionSupport.scope: Confirm which beds, hedges, and lawn areas are included and what the visit covers.
decisionSupport.nextStep: Share the property address and the work you want handled so the team can confirm the right visit.
decisionSupport.preparation: Note the areas that need the most attention and whether the property has irrigation or a regular mowing schedule.

services.name: Irrigation service
services.description: Seasonal start-up, adjustments, and winterization for existing irrigation systems.

decisionSupport.scope: Describe the existing system, the number of zones, and whether the issue is coverage, timing, or a leak.
decisionSupport.nextStep: Share the property address and system details so the team can confirm the appropriate service.
decisionSupport.preparation: Note the controller make, any visible leaks, and the last time the system was started or winterized.

services.name: Hardscape installation
services.description: Paths, patios, and retaining walls planned with the planting and drainage in mind.

decisionSupport.scope: Discuss the intended use, the slope, the drainage, and how the hardscape connects to the planting.
decisionSupport.nextStep: A site visit confirms the measurements and the construction approach before a scope is proposed.
decisionSupport.preparation: Bring photos, a rough sketch, and any survey or property documents that show the boundaries.

differentiators: One crew from plan to planting
A clear scope before work begins
Seasonal care built around the property

faqs.question: Do you design and maintain gardens?
faqs.answer: Yes. The same team can prepare a planting plan and care for the garden through the seasons, or handle only the part you need.

faqs.question: How is service-area coverage confirmed?
faqs.answer: Share the full property address. The team will confirm current coverage and availability before scheduling a visit.

faqs.question: What happens at the first visit?
faqs.answer: The team walks the property, reviews the light and existing planting, and talks through the work you are considering. The visit is used to prepare a clear scope, not to pressure a decision.
